about_dialog_desc.message: A modern e-book reader designed for web, browsers, and mobile devices, featuring multi-format parsing, high-quality Edge neural TTS, smart AI companions, and deep reading statistics.

about_feature_1.message: Format support: EPUB, AZW3, MOBI, TXT, MD, FB2, CBZ, etc.

about_feature_2.message: Speech Engine: High-quality Microsoft Edge Neural TTS with gapless dual-player preloading and background keep-alive

about_feature_3.message: Typography: Continuous scroll & paginated layouts, custom fonts (LXGW, Noto Serif) and texture overlays

about_feature_4.message: AI Assistant: Seamlessly connects to local Gemini Nano and cloud/local LLMs (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama) for text analysis

about_feature_5.message: Data & Platforms: Analytics time distribution, calendar heatmap, zip backups; runs as Extension, PWA, or native Android App

about_usage_1.message: Import: Click the 'Import Book' button or drag and drop book files onto the library bookshelf.

about_usage_2.message: Reading & TTS: Click a book to read. Click the speaker icon to open the TTS controls; click any sentence to read from it.

about_usage_3.message: Highlights: Select any text while reading to launch the annotation toolbar for highlights, notes, and AI features.

about_usage_4.message: Backup: Click 'More' -> 'Backup' to export all books and progress into a single .zip file.

about_tip_content.message: We strongly recommend downloading the offline single-file HTML version! Running it locally by double-clicking bypasses CORS and server proxy restrictions, letting you fully leverage Microsoft Edge's high-quality online Natural TTS Engine.

ai_suggest_sum_chapter_prt.message: Help me summarize the core arguments and main contents of the current chapter.

ai_suggest_chapter_map_prt.message:
Please structure the content of the current chapter and output a Mermaid mindmap diagram. Adjust your focus based on the book's genre (for fiction/stories, focus on timeline and plot; for non-fiction/academic, focus on core arguments and logical derivation). Strict rules: 1) Must be wrapped in a ```mermaid code block; 2) First line must be 'mindmap'; 3) Use ONLY indentation for hierarchy, do NOT use arrows -->, ::icon(), subgraph, or any other syntax; 4) Keep node text simple without parentheses or special symbols; 5) Keep node text extremely brief (recommended 2-5 words/characters, maximum 10) and avoid long sentences to prevent node overlapping; 6) Reference format: mindmap
  root(Topic)
    Branch 1
      Point A
      Point B
    Branch 2
      Point C

ai_suggest_book_map_prt.message:
Please combine the context retrieved from the entire book to structure the overall framework and core chapter logic, and output a Mermaid mindmap diagram. Adjust your focus based on the book's genre (for fiction/stories, focus on timeline and plot; for non-fiction/academic, focus on core arguments and logical derivation). Strict rules: 1) Must be wrapped in a ```mermaid code block; 2) First line must be 'mindmap'; 3) Use ONLY indentation for hierarchy, do NOT use arrows -->, ::icon(), subgraph, or any other syntax; 4) Keep node text simple without parentheses or special symbols; 5) Keep node text extremely brief (recommended 2-5 words/characters, maximum 10) and avoid long sentences to prevent node overlapping; 6) Reference format: mindmap
  root(Book Title)
    Part 1
      Key Point 1
      Key Point 2
    Part 2
      Key Point 3

ai_suggest_takeaways_prt.message: Analyze the 3-5 most important key concepts and takeaways from the current chapter or the entire book.

ai_suggest_characters_prt.message: Structure the main characters, character backgrounds, and the network of relationships between them in this book.

ai_suggest_explain_concept_prt.message: Explain the core professional terminology or deep concepts mentioned in the current context of this book.

ai_suggest_quiz_prt.message: Based on the content of the current chapter, design 3 reading comprehension or self-test thinking questions for me to help deepen my understanding.
